name: vera-discussion-assistant

scripts.test:coverage:python: python3 -m coverage run --data-file=coverage/.coverage --branch --source=src.python.transcribe -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m coverage report --data-file=coverage/.coverage --fail-under=95 --show-missing && python3 -m coverage xml --data-file=coverage/.coverage -o coverage/python.xml

description: A local assistant for project discussions: recordings, translated issue drafts, human review, and approved GitHub publishing
